# Mirabel Cotton & Tommy

- [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) — Sibling of — [Tommy](../character/tommy.md) — brother · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P34](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0034)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Rebelling against Mrs. Lynde's instructions, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) and go fishing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons) instead. After lying to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to cover up his misdeeds, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) suffers from a guilty conscience and late that night confesses everything to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who forgives him and instructs him to pray for forgiveness.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors
